instruction: My uncle is a programmer who finds the monospace code font too small when viewing source code. Could you increase the fixed-width font size in Chrome to at least 16 pixels for better code readability?

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting the default fixed-width (monospace) font size to at least 16 pixels. The evaluator checks if default_fixed_font_size >= 16. Fixed-width fonts are used for displaying code, terminal output, and other monospaced content.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts the Chrome default_fixed_font_size setting from webkit.webprefs in the Chrome Preferences file
Metric correctly validates that the font size is at least 16 pixels using range check (min=16, max=99999)
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the single requirement (fixed-width font size >= 16 pixels)
Proper postconfig: Chrome is restarted to ensure preferences are written and can be read
Data flow is correct: getter extracts the right Chrome setting, metric compares against the correct threshold
Edge case handling: getter has try-except with default value fallback (13)
Cross-platform support: getter handles Windows, macOS, and Linux preference file paths correctly
